release_notes:
Ship a clean custom-field seed for fresh installs

The install template seeded 38 custom fields with ZERO attachments and
no products/services using them — every new customer inherited a tangle
of supplier/IMEI fields (GSX, Case ID, MEID, MSLsn, SamKey TMO, Z3X...)
that were pure clutter.

Trim the seed to the 5 generic shop/retail fields a default install
actually needs (Serial No, Email, Quantity, Username, Password) and drop
the custom-field dropdown options (all belonged to removed fields). New
customers now start clean and add their own fields as they build
services. AUTO_INCREMENT (77) leaves headroom so new fields never
collide with the seeded ones.
